correctness.rationale: Differentiating \(H=\log[(r-\alpha)/(\beta-r)]/[\varepsilon(\beta-\alpha)]-\log(1-x)\) yields \([\theta-(1+\theta)x]P_D\) exactly. Positivity and periodicity justify division and zero boundary integral. For \(\(N=2\)\), \(P_D=r_dx/2\) yields \(\operatorname{Var}(x)=\bar x[\theta/(1+\theta)-\bar x]\). An explicit rational Hurwitz Jacobian guarantees a genuine smooth attracting forced 2pi-cycle for all sufficiently small nonzero sinusoidal amplitudes. Complex frequency response gives exact coefficient \(\(625/52372\)\), corroborated by standalone symbolic checks and four numerical periodic shots.
